page.overview:
What is Island Xtreme Stunts?

Island Xtreme Stunts is a theme that was introduced in 2002 and was discontinued a year later in 2003. It was based on the success of the 1997 video game, LEGO Island, and the 2001 video game, LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge. A video game based on this theme was made for the PC, PlayStation 2 and Game Boy Advance and released in late 2002.

Although the theme is said to have been released in 2002, a promotional set that was part of it, 3925 Brickster Key Chain, was released in late 2001.

The theme took place on LEGO Island after the events of the video game, LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge, and featured Pepper Roni, an avid skateboarder and pizza delivery boy and star of the first two LEGO Island video games, and his friends engaging in skateboarding, windsurfing, and other land and aerial activities. In most of the sets, Pepper and his friends need to catch the master crook, The Brickster, and/or his henchmen (replacing the Brickster-Bots).

A video game of the same name was developed by Silicon Dreams (developer behind LEGO Island 2: The Brickster's Revenge and LEGO Soccer Mania) along with the set line, and featured Pepper as the star in an action movie called Xtreme Stunts, with the same events in the missions taking place as some of the sets. The video game was released in late 2002 for the PC, PlayStation 2 and Game Boy Advance. The new characters, such as Sky Lane, The Director, Liam Lense, Phil Maker, Lucky Larry, etc. have appeared in the video game.
